rows.label: Official test: self-employed (contratto d'opera)
rows.value: Civil code art. 2222: a person who undertakes a work or service for a fee, mainly with their own labour and without subordination to the client

rows.label: Collaborations organised by the client (collaborazioni etero-organizzate)
rows.value: Mainly personal, continuous work whose way of working is organised by the client, including through digital platforms, is treated as employment from 1 January 2016 (D.Lgs. 81/2015 art. 2(1)); exceptions for collective agreements, registered professions, company officers and some others

rows.label: Continuous collaborations (co.co.co.)
